title: Urban Water Management Solutions
description: Published research paper in the International Journal of Environmental Engineering on sustainable urban water management solutions.
studentRemarks: This paper represents six months of fieldwork and analysis. It has already been cited by three other researchers in the field.

title: International Conference on Quantum Computing
description: Presentation at the annual quantum computing conference focusing on advancements in qubit stability.
studentRemarks: Includes novel experimental data and theoretical models. Received positive feedback during peer review.

title: AI in Healthcare Diagnostics
description: Developed an AI model for early detection of diabetic retinopathy using retinal fundus images.
studentRemarks: Model achieved 95% accuracy in preliminary tests. Peer-reviewed and accepted for publication in JMIR.

title: Renewable Energy Storage Systems: A Comparative Analysis
description: Investigated new battery technologies for grid-scale energy storage, comparing lithium-ion with emerging solid-state batteries.
studentRemarks: Further research needed to validate the long-term stability and cost-effectiveness of the proposed solid-state materials. Scope was too broad for current project phase.
